mapper.select: SELECT ID, PROVIDER, USER_ID, PROVIDER_EMAIL, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CREATED_AT) * 1000 CREATED_AT FROM T_OAUTH WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_OAUTH (ID, PROVIDER, USER_ID, PROVIDER_EMAIL) VALUES (#{id}, #{provider}, #{userId}, #{providerEmail})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM T_OAUTH WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND PROVIDER = #{provider}
